_doc: Rival column sets for fig_ladder. One entry = one panel. To add a set: append an entry with status 'landed', its artefact, a reader and the arm map; add its caption line to the draft. No code change. Readers: 'ladder_csv' (w12 LADDER.csv layout: rung,k,seed,arm,mean_distinct_valid_novel_tuples) and 'json_path' (value = the JSON leaf at path_template with {n}, {seed}, {arm} substituted). Every set is drawn beside the same store and floor.
